positions.description: Tech lead for Amazon's Cart API

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded agile development team to redesign legacy applications to improve loading/saving process, user experience and intuitiveness.
- Developed analytical tools for healthcare systems to help cost leaders identify, plan and track continuous cost improvements in their organization in C#/.NET.
- Conducted unit testing on frameworks and data warehouses using NUnit framework and automated UI tests with Selenium.

company.name: Purdue University's Healthcare Information Visualization Engineering Lab (HIVELab)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
POET (Purdue Optimization modeling Education Tool) project
- Analyze and Improve User Interface design.
- Developed Linear Program tool for students to formulate optimization models with visual interface and feedback to self-assess their work by building conceptual understanding.
(https://engineering.purdue.edu/HIVELab/wiki/pmwiki.php/POET)

Semi-Structured Review 
- Developed web-based interactive tool using Ruby on Rails.
- Utilized jQuery and AJAX for design and application feedback.
- Web application deployed at http://caniask.net/

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-	Taught Programming Applications for Engineers Course (CS 159) using MATLAB and C programming language to undergraduate students.
-	Improved problem-solving skills by analyzing and debugging students’ programs.
-	Hold office hours to address student concerns.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Material Science Engineering at Purdue University
positions.description:
-	In charge of micromechanical modeling of biomimetic nanocomposites using numerical methods and rigid particle dynamics.
-	Carried out and accomplished visualization and deformation of nacre using Tecplot.
-	Uploaded a large-scale simulation tool to NanoHUB.org. (http://nanohub.org/resources/nacresimulator)

positions.title: Quality Engineer
positions.description:
- Conducted statistical process control to ensure quality conformance of six sigma is achieved.
- Identified tractor and transmission significant characteristics, leak points and common defect areas.
- Implemented data management skills to update the company’s assembly line status and repair database.

positions.title: Software Programmer/Web Designer
positions.description:
-	Implemented Microsoft Visual Studio and MySQL to create databases and management software.
-	Enhanced the company’s webpage by utilizing C++ and C# programming language.  
-	Gained teamwork experience by working with other colleagues of different cultures and races.
